nom: Rael Miracle Clear Pore Purifying Clay Mask

avis.texte: i began having hormonal acne in early febuary of 2026 that came out of nowhere- i mean i had never experienced acne this bad before. it was painful, red, and constant, and even at this time i wasnt a big makeup wearer due to my dry, sensitive skin and excema. i used loreal lumiglotion and mascara, neither of which had ever given me issues before. during the trial and error of a new anti-acne skincare routine, i purchased this product and fell in love. it deserves all five stars that im giving it. it shrinks my pores, picks up oil, and calms down breakouts/active acne. as someone whose skin is scent-sensitive, the smell of this mask did not bother me or my skin. its light and clay-like, nothing artifical. i usually use this once a week on my whole face, and will otherwise target specific areas if need be. i do recommend this product to anyone struggling with hormonal acne, larger pores, or oily/combo skin.
Love how easy it is to apply and take off. Works very well for my skin! I have combo hormonal acne

I have had really sensitive skin and hormonal acne the past few months and very few products have proven effective. To my absolute shock, this has been huge aid in managing my breakouts. My skin is the best it has been in months and this product truly works!
My pores did feel smaller after first use! Was much wasier to wash off than other pore masks I've used in the past which was a huge plus!

I was looking for a mask that would not be a complete nightmare to wash off. This fits the bill. Tighten my skin after first use and minimized my pores! highly highly recommend this! there is no smell that others mentioned.

it smells like when your earrings get crusty from infection. you can't pop open the bottle in the store to do a smell test, it's sealed. if i had known it smelled so bad, i absolutely wouldn't have bought it. product works as promised, though, hence my 4 stars. i don't understand why these companies make such horrible smelling products - maybe the psychology behind it is that if it smelled good it won't seem like it's "working" as well? it's so nasty.

avis.titre: My Breakout Reset in a Tube
avis.texte: When I'm breaking out, this mask is my go-to reset. It soothes while treating acne and never irritates or dries out my sensitive skin. I love that I can apply a thick layer for a deep purge or a thin one for a lighter refresh.
I use the Rael Clay Mask once a week for a deep pore cleanse. It detoxifies my skin and leaves it feeling fresh and smooth every time. Perfect for keeping breakouts and excess oil at bay!

avis.titre: Finally, a mask that actually WORKS!!
avis.texte: So, with all of my health issues I have able time that has to be spend resting. I've used this time to take care of my skin. While clay masks are super fun, they don't do much, and if you've tried one- you've tried them all. But not this one! To start off, it's a super thin formula. Very runny. I doubted it would work when I applied it because it went on in such a thin layer. But I was wrong! It dried super fast, felt great on my skin, and was easy to remove. And the best part? My skin felt AMAZING afterwords! Just to be clear- this product alone will not be enough to give you flawless skin. But in addition to a regular skin care routine it can definitely make a difference!

Sunday & Wednesday are my exfoliation/mask days. First time using this, my skin instantly felt super smooth as I washed it off. I leave it on for the full 10 minutes to really allow it so work. This is going to remain a part of my skincare routine for a long while. Love it!
Use twice a week and it has been great face mask. It's helping my acne so I love it. If you have acne prone skin this is the face mask for you in my opinion!
This is the first face mask I've tried that I can clearly see the results!

This mask has a nice, earthy smell not overbearing. I like that one of the ingredients is tea tree. I think that's a nice natural ingredient to tackle acne prone skin. After removing the mask my face didn't feel dried out at all. It looked super clear and I followed it up with the miracle barrier cream. I didn't get any irritation.
I absolutely hate the smell. I wouldn't repurchase plus, I don't think it helped my skin at all.

I only used this mask once, but it felt so wonderful and didn't dry out and tighten my skin in the bath. Normally, I cannot wear a mask as long as I wore this one without discomfort. My pores felt cleansed and tightened immediately afterwards.
This leaves my skin clean and soft without drying. I didn't think I'd love a mask more than Cl@rins

This mask does exactly what is claims. My skin has been to clear up since using this in conjunction with the othe items in the Miracle Clear collection. It rinses clean and my skin doesn't feel stripped, dry or irritated. It gets all the gunk out of my pores.
It goes on really easily and really makes my skin feel clean and refreshed. It isn't as messy and the Aztec clay but does as good of a job getting down into my skin. Everyone needs this!
Probably very effective, but I must be sensitive to it because I was red and stinging afterwards. Check the ingredients for your sensitivities.
It goes on really easily and really makes my skin feel clean and refreshed. It isn't as messy and the Aztec clay but does as good of a job getting down into my skin. Everyone needs this!

avis.titre: Rael Beauty - Miracle Clear Pore Control
avis.texte: Rael Beauty - Miracle Clear Pore Control -Clean K-Beauty -Vegan -Cruelty Free -Papaya Extract -Cica Extract -Parabens & Fragrance Free I received two products from a new K-Beauty brand I've never heard of but was eager to try! Both products are clean & cruelty free & aimed towards acne prone skin. I have sensitive skin & my skin loved these products. I had zero irritation & it actually calmed a bit of my rosacea redness down. I didn't receive the Miracle Clear Barrier Cream both products were recommended to try after use but I would absolutely try it. Pore Purifying Clay Mask -made of mineral rich Kaolin Clay - infused with Papaya and Jeju Mugwort Extracts After I cleansed my face, I applied an even layer of the mask all over my skin. After 10 mins, I wiped it clean. Whilst on, it has a tea tree scent which I love & tingles just a bit. Tea tree products tend to leave the skin cool & minty but nothing overpowering. After it dried & I cleansed it off, I noticed that the pores on my nose looked smaller. The next morning while putting on my makeup, I definitely noticed a difference in pore size. My sensitive skin wasn't currently breaking out as I was trying this so I didn't notice a difference in controlling acne but it did make a noticeable difference with the size of my pores. I enjoyed the mask overall, it wasn't drying at all & left my skin feeling hydrated after. I would recommend to anyone looking for a clean skincare option & a wonderful pore reducing mask that is non dry
